statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There is concern for a paroxysmal arrhythmia as the underlying etiology
The patient has a history of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances
The diagnoses are G45.9 and R42
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The service is excluded from the patient's specific coverage terms
